About Us
ABOUT US
At Mitsubishi Heavy Industries (MHI) Group, we channel big thinking into solutions that MOVE THE WORLD FORWARD - advancing the lives of everyone who shares our planet. Find out how we bring people and businesses around the globe together to pave the way to a future of shared success.
Learn more: COMPANY OVERVIEW
The concept behind our brand -
MOVE THE WORLD FORWARD
Mitsubishi Heavy Industries (MHI) Group is one of the world’s leading industrial groups, spanning energy, logistics & infrastructure, industrial machinery, aerospace and defense.
Learn more: OUTLINE OF MHI GROUP
MHI Group’s Declaration to Achieve Carbon Neutrality by 2040
MHI Group combines cutting-edge technology with deep experience to deliver innovative, integrated solutions that help to realize a carbon neutral world, improve quality of life and ensure a safer world.
Learn more: 2040 CARBON NEUTRALITY DECLARATION
